{{Top|leg}}
'''Noise inhibitors''' were capable of masking private conversations with the added benefit of not alerting any potential eavesdroppers to the fact that they had been detected. [[Dalabar Micro-Electronics]] produced the [[NI-632]] noise inhibitor.
